newsitem.title: USA: Vepco, GM set electric vehicle marketing effort.
newsitem.headline: Vepco, GM set electric vehicle marketing effort.

text.p: Dominion Resources Inc said Thursday its Virginia Power subsidiary and General Motors Corp plan a joint initiative to develop plans to market electric vehicles and electric vehicle infrastructure in Virginia and the Southeast.

The alliance between GM and Virginia Power recognizes their mutual interest in developing an overall business plan for the marketing of S-10 electric pickup trucks and Delco Electronics' Magne Charge inductive vehicle chargers in the southeast region.
The utility noted it is an authorized distributor of the vehicle chargers made by GM's Delco Electronics.

GM will begin selling the S-10 Electric to fleets in l997. The S-10 Electric is an original equipment manufactured (OEM) vehicle -- built from the ground up as an electric vehicle -- which GM will begin selling to fleets in 1997.
